chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Isḥāq ibn Saʿd, from Mūsā ibn al-Khazraj, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: I go out to my two estates, and from my home to them is twelve farsakhs. Should I perform the salat (prayer) in full or shorten it? He said: Perform it in full.

key_terms.اثْنَا عَشَرَ فَرْسَخًا: a travel distance of twelve farsakhs
key_terms.ضَيْعَتَيَّ: my two landed estates or properties

ai.seo_question: Should a person shorten or complete salat (prayer) when traveling to his own estate?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about salat (prayer) during travel to one’s estate. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام instructs that the prayer should be performed in full, indicating that this type of travel does not require shortening the prayer.
